independent_issues.title: Universal application claims
independent_issues.detail: Every LLM/structured-extraction/production NLP pipeline using grammar/POS/dependencies is a source generalization, not a result of this review.

independent_issues.title: POS as universally necessary for lemmatization
independent_issues.detail: Always/cannot are source overstatements; source tutorial lookup configuration does not establish all lemmatizers require externally supplied POS.

independent_issues.title: Parsing collapsed into token classification
independent_issues.detail: Structured dependency or constituency tree recovery is not universally equivalent to independent per-token classification; source simplification retained.

independent_issues.title: Tag inventory and root conventions
independent_issues.detail: 36-tag PTB description omits inventory conventions such as punctuation; UD POS tags versus full dependency annotation distinguished. Single head wording requires a root convention. The illustrative dependency labels prep/pobj are not uniformly UD labels.

independent_issues.title: Benchmark numbers and agreement ceiling
independent_issues.detail: Brown 85/93%, CRF97%, model98%+, PTB97% agreement, and models beyond98% probably overfitting lack corpus split/config/metric context. Human disagreement is not automatically a hard ceiling on matching a chosen gold annotation. No Brown data or accuracy benchmark executed.

independent_issues.title: Bigram HMM disambiguation limitation overstated
independent_issues.detail: Local transition and emission context can disambiguate some noun/verb cases; a categorical cannot for the shown saw examples is not demonstrated.

independent_issues.title: EOS counted but not used in terminal Viterbi choice
independent_issues.detail: Original training counts EOS, while decoding maximizes final V scores without EOS transition. Independent fixture decodes A; same path calculation with EOS picks B. Exhaustive 27-path check passes for the actual source objective.

independent_issues.title: Smoothing and probability contracts
independent_issues.detail: train_hmm alpha does not affect counts; smoothing is applied at decoding. alpha=.01 is additive smoothing rather than the strict add-one case. Unknown emissions share an implicit reserved mass; no explicit UNK token. Positive alpha/domain requirements absent.

independent_issues.title: Input validation and ties
independent_issues.detail: Empty training/tokens/tagset and zero-alpha unseen words raise IndexError or ValueError; zip silently truncates token/tag length mismatch. Set-to-list order determines Viterbi ties; MFT ties follow encounter order. No correction made.

independent_issues.title: Parsing family and accuracy simplifications
independent_issues.detail: Arc construction is not only a generic reduce operation for all transition systems. Eisner projectivity and graph-decoding constraints matter; slower/more accurate is not unconditional. Kept as source risk without expanded research.

independent_issues.title: External models, versioned outputs and zero-shot claims
independent_issues.detail: spaCy output depends on model/tokenizer version; Stanza/trankit/NLTK coverage/performance and language-neutral tags do not establish zero-shot accuracy. All external libraries, models and downloads skipped.

independent_issues.title: Artifact and visual scope
independent_issues.detail: Two figure identifiers and all references preserved. Prompt is source text, not invoked skill. Exercises, live library calls, remote references and interactive figures not executed or browser-validated by reviewer.
